sourceTitle: Lennox SL280DFNV installation instructions 508150-02 (04/2024), integrated control diagnostic codes
safetyNote: If you smell gas, do not touch any electrical switch or use a phone in the building; leave immediately and call your gas supplier from outside. Turn off electrical power at the furnace switch or breaker before opening any panel, and never bypass or jumper a limit, rollout or pressure switch. Gas valve, burner, venting, wiring and control-board work should be done by a licensed HVAC technician.
displayPattern: Seven-segment diagnostic LED on a Lennox SL280DFNV. This is not the red and green LED pair on an ML180.
meaning: Hard lockout: the rollout circuit is open, or it was open.
causes: Rollout switch was open and the cause has not been corrected
diySteps: Leave the furnace off. Do not reset a rollout switch and try another cycle
Technician: correct the cause of the rollout trip, or replace the flame rollout switch, then test furnace operation. The code clears after the fault is recovered
proAdvice: E200 is a rollout hard lockout. It is not the ML180 pattern of red slow flash with green on, and it is not E250 (limit circuit open). Call a licensed HVAC technician.
